title: getting-started
text: sentinelBurnR provides tools analysing wildfire environmental context using satellite climate data. package uses Sentinel-2 multispectral imagery identify burned areas examine vegetation condition. can also compare vegetation moisture historical observations place observations context climate data rainfall. typical analysis can include: defining area interest; identifying suitable Sentinel-2 imagery; comparing pre- post-fire imagery; analysing vegetation condition; assessing vegetation moisture anomalies; examining recent rainfall climate conditions. vignette uses data Dunwich area Suffolk, UK, associated wildfire summer 2026. example data included package, vignette can run without downloading data.

title: A package to track changes in vegetation and habitat, including from wildfires, based on sentinel 2 images
text: R package detecting mapping wildfire impacts Sentinel-2 imagery. sentinelBurnR provides end--end workflow wildfire analysis using Sentinel-2 Level-2A imagery. handles image discovery, download, cloud masking, compositing, burn index calculation visualisation, allowing users move area interest burn severity products lines code. Features Create areas interest coordinates spatial objects Search Sentinel-2 STAC catalogues Parallel image downloads Local project-based image storage Pixel-level cloud masking using Sentinel-2 Scene Classification Layer (SCL) Multi-date median compositing Multi-tile mosaicking Calculate: Normalized Burn Ratio (NBR) Differenced Normalized Burn Ratio (dNBR) Publication-quality plotting using ggplot2 tidyterra Project-based workflow reproducible analyses ## Installation
